description: CR 510.2 two simultaneous hits still leave exactly 1
note: CR 510.2's simultaneity, and CR 120.4d's first Worship example scaled down: two attackers, each of which alone would carry alice past the floor. Reading each against the PRE-BATCH life would cut both to a loss of 1 and leave her at 0, dead to CR 704.5a. The second attacker is a Child of Night rather than a second Celestine: CR 704.5j would bury one of two legends, and the two amounts differ, which no single number could tell apart.
